package main

// 座標の [0] が列か行かを、ソースの使われ方から決められない作品。推測せず判定しない。

const (
	rows     = 5
	cols     = 5
	tileSize = 16
	tileWall = 1
)

var roomMaps [1][rows][cols]int
var keyPos = [1][2]int{{1, 3}}
var exitPos = [1][2]int{{3, 1}}

func buildMaps() {
	for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
		roomMaps[0][2][x] = tileWall
	}
}

func nearKey(room, a, b int) bool {
	return keyPos[room][0] == a && keyPos[room][1] == b
}

func nearExit(room, a, b int) bool {
	return exitPos[room][0] == a && exitPos[room][1] == b
}

type Game struct{ px, py float64 }

func (g *Game) reset() {
	buildMaps()
	g.px = float64(1*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.py = float64(1*tileSize + tileSize/2)
}

func main() {}
